steps.text: Three times the fowlbeast has flown past the window. Perhaps it had already flown past many times before Gnosis noticed it.
The fowlbeasts of Kjerag build their nests in the mountains. The adults leave their nests before the sun rises, foraging in human lands.
The cold climate has made them strong and sturdy.
Track the flight of a fowlbeast, and one will find that they traverse half of Kjerag in the span of a single day.
At least, that is what the books at home say.

steps.name: Teacher
steps.text: Let's continue from where we left off yesterday, then.

steps.name: Teacher
steps.text: The institutions of Kjerag share certain characteristics with Victoria.

steps.name: Teacher
steps.text: The three clans are analogous to the grand dukes of Victoria, while the Vine-Bead Court performs some of the functions of the king.

steps.name: Teacher
steps.text: By understanding Victoria's institutions, you will gain a greater understanding of where the two systems are similar, and an even greater understanding of where they are different.

steps.name: Teacher
steps.text: Do you concur, Master Enciodes?

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: I think I know what you mean.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Kjerag's institutions are built upon faith in Kjeragandr. Therefore, despite the similarities with Victoria's institutions, they are fundamentally different.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: As written in the 'Kjeragandr', the three clans formed a covenant with Kjeragandr to lead the people. The mantle of authority is merely an insignificant reward.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: On this point, the relationship between the three clans and the Vine-Bead Court is fundamentally different from the relationship between the Victorian dukes and the king.

steps.name: Teacher
steps.text: Excellent, Master Enciodes...
Gnosis pays no heed to the exchange, letting his mind wander and imagine the fowlbeast outside the winding gliding on the winds.
These fowlbeasts are smart creatures. They are waiting for leftovers from lunch that the kitchens will throw out soon. The Silverash food is among the finest in Kjerag, after all.
After they have had their fill, they will fly towards Lake Silberneherze, frolicking on the meadows there, or interact with the burdenbeasts basking in the sun.
If they are lucky, they will be thrown a scalecis or two by the fincatchers on the ice.
When the sun sets in the west, they will return to their warm nests and put an end to a productive day, like someone who has just finished a hard day of work.

steps.name: Teacher
steps.text: This concludes today's lesson.

steps.name: Teacher
steps.text: We will have our regular short quiz now.
Gnosis stares at the quiz paper. He finds the questions even easier than a fowlbeast finds looking for food.
His mind wanders to how fowlbeasts live their entire lives between looking for food and sleeping, interposed by the occasional territorial conflict, day after day, year after year, until they die.
It seems almost like there is some kind of law governing it, because the fowlbeasts of Kjerag do not appear to ever think about flying beyond the mountains.

steps.name: Teacher
steps.text: Time's up.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: I had two questions that I wasn't sure about. What about you, Gnosis?

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: I—

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Let me guess, you finished ages ago.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Hm? Some of your answers are different from mine—

steps.name: Teacher
steps.text: Now, now, Master Enciodes, Master Gnosis grew up in the Edelweiss sea of books.

steps.name: Teacher
steps.text: Your advantages lie elsewhere, do they not?

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Is that supposed to console me?

steps.name: Teacher
steps.text: Put it another way, the higher Master Gnosis's academic achievements, the more help you will receive as the future head of Clan Silverash.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Very well.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Shoot, I need to meet Matterhorn. I'll be going.

steps.name: Teacher
steps.text: Of course.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Say, Gnosis—

steps.name: Teacher
steps.text: One moment, please, Gnosis.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Did you need something, Enciodes?

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Oh, er, it's nothing important.

steps.name: Teacher
steps.text: Here's your last test back.

steps.name: Teacher
steps.text: Full marks, as usual.

steps.name: Teacher
steps.text: Your grades are spectacular, Gnosis. You're the brightest student I've ever seen.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Thank you.

steps.name: Teacher
steps.text: I can already picture you on a bigger stage when you study abroad in Victoria.

steps.name: Teacher
steps.text: Patriarch Olafur's study abroad policy is practically tailored to you.

steps.name: Teacher
steps.text: But this supposed signature of your father's is forged, isn't it?

steps.name: Teacher
steps.text: I'm guessing you didn't think you could keep it hidden forever. Your family will eventually find out, after all.

steps.name: Teacher
steps.text: But the longer it takes for them to find out, the better your chance of making this a done deal.

steps.name: Teacher
steps.text: This is the best you could do.

steps.name: Teacher
steps.text: But it's not enough.

steps.name: Teacher
steps.text: Tell me, Gnosis, what do you think of Kjerag after learning about Victoria's institutions?

steps.name: Teacher
steps.text: Don't worry, this is a private conversation. You can trust me to keep a secret.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: It's backwards and inefficient.

steps.name: Teacher
steps.text: What do you think about Enciodes, then?

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: ...He will be a respectable leader.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: But i don't understand him.

steps.name: Teacher
steps.text: What don't you understand?

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: His sense of duty, like he was born to lead Kjerag.

steps.name: Teacher
steps.text: Ah, good. You're even more radical than I thought.

steps.name: Teacher
steps.text: It appears that knowledge has given you more questions than it has answers.

steps.name: Teacher
steps.text: Kjerag is clearly too small for you, Gnosis.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: I don't know.

steps.name: Teacher
steps.text: Don't fool yourself. You would forge your father's signature in order to study abroad.

steps.name: Teacher
steps.text: You want to get out, don't you?

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: My father would never agree.

steps.name: Teacher
steps.text: Your little trick won't work. But I can help you.

steps.name: Teacher
steps.text: I can act as if I never noticed. I could even pretend to have seen your father and gotten his consent for you to study abroad.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Why?

steps.name: Teacher
steps.text: Because you're like me.

steps.name: Teacher
steps.text: I'm on your side, Gnosis.

steps.name: Teacher
steps.text: Friends help each other. I helped you. Now I need you to help me with something.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Hey.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Hm?

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Gnosis!

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Enciodes? You're back?

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: I was going to ask you to come along, but then you had to stay late.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Go along where?

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: The first train that Father purchased from Victoria is making a test run today. Do you want to watch?

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Why me?

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Hm... because we're classmates?

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Plus, aren't you interested? It's a train! Kjerag's first ever!

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: I—
'I'm not interested. I'm going home.'
The words die in his throat.
He could imagine what awaits him back home.
His mother preparing dinner, waiting for his son to bring good news about his studies.
His father buried in his research in a sea of books, with eyes only for the millennia of Kjerag history.
He probably does not know what time it is. He probably does not remember what his son is doing.
When he reads something that excites him, he will call out to his son, then his wife will tell him that his son is studying with the son of Master Olafur.
He would mutter a response and continue with his research. By the time his son came home, he would have forgotten what he wanted to say.
He would talk nonstop at the dinner table about what he discovered that day, and what he would discover the next.
To Gnosis, his father is like a drowning man stretching out his hand to tell his son about all the mysteries hidden in the lake.
If that is the case—

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Well? What's the answer? Are you going or not?

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: ...I'm going.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: That's more like it!

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Shh—

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Alright, the coast is clear.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Why is the scion of Silverash acting like a thief?

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Because Father won't actually let me watch.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Why?

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: He says that the train is still being tested, and it might be dangerous.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Then you—

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: I'm curious.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: We so much to learn about engineering, science, and literature every day. It makes my head want to explode.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: But it's things that we have to learn. So I want to at least see what learning these things could do for me.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: You don't like them either?

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Well... I didn't, at first.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: But I found a way.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: A way?

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: I began thinking about what knowledge can become.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: For example, all the knowledge about engineering that eventually becomes a train.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: I've found that it motivates me to study when I actually get to see the things I read about.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: You're so strange.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Am I?

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Just imagine. This train will let us traverse all of Kjerag in a single day once it enters service.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: And we built it with our own hands. It's exciting, isn't it?

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: You—

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: What is it?

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: You're even more childish than I thought.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: I don't want to be like my father, always engaged in a battle of wit and will against nobles and merchants from abroad. He doesn't even smile when he's with his family.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: He didn't use to be like that.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: You're going to be a leader. You need to get used to it.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Maybe. If that's the case, then at least I'll smile and laugh to my heart's content before I get to that point.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Say, I used to think you were one of those people whose brain is filled with Kjerag history and nothing else.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: But you're always watching the fowlbeasts outside the window. That's when I began to think that you may be different from how I imagined.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Well...

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Do you enjoy observing them?

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: No—

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: The train's about to stop.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Let's get off here. We'll get a terrible earful if we're found out.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Enciodes.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Yes?

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Would you accompany me somewhere?

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Alright.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Why did you bring me here?

steps.name: Teacher
steps.text: Friends help each other. I helped you. Now I need you to help me with something.

steps.name: Teacher
steps.text: Bring Enciodes. I want to have a chat with him too.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: I'm not sure. But the teacher said he wanted to see you here?

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: He did?

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Who's there?!

steps.name: Teacher
steps.text: No need to get excited. Just letting Master Enciodes take a little nap.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Sir?!

steps.name: Teacher
steps.text: Take him.

steps.name: Bounty Hunter
steps.text: Righto.

steps.name: Teacher
steps.text: Now, now, be gentle with the young master.

steps.name: Bounty Hunter
steps.text: Don't worry, I'll be careful. He's our money, after all.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Who are you?!

steps.name: Teacher
steps.text: Just a tutor who was hired to instruct the scions of Clans Silverash and Edelweiss.

steps.name: Teacher
steps.text: Being a tutor doesn't pay that well, though, so I started a little side business.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: What do you want?

steps.name: Teacher
steps.text: Don't look at me like that. You brought him here, didn't you?

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Why you—!

steps.name: Teacher
steps.text: My dear Master Gnosis, did you really think I didn't talk to your parents?

steps.name: Teacher
steps.text: Just as you suspected, your father refused to consent to you studying abroad, and your mother is against it too.

steps.name: Teacher
steps.text: You believe you could make this a done deal, but my feeling is that they will come after you, no matter how far you run.

steps.name: Teacher
steps.text: I'm helping you, Master Gnosis.

steps.name: Teacher
steps.text: If you want to leave Kjerag, get away from this boring, dead-end life—

steps.name: Teacher
steps.text: Tell your parents and Master Olafur...

steps.name: Teacher
steps.text: That Master Enciodes and you will be sowing your wild oats for a while, and you don't want to be disturbed.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Master Olafur? It's me, Gnosis.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Yes, Master Enciodes is with me.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: I'm sorry, we sneaked onto the train. I just wanted to let you know, so you won't worry too much about us.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: ...No, he hasn't caused me any trouble. It was I—

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: When will we be back?
Gnosis looks up to see a flock of fowlbeasts streak across the sky.
A young fowlbeast separates from the flock, flying off in another direction, beyond the snow-capped mountains.
The northern wind often gives fledglings reckless courage, the belief that they can break the iron-clad rules, but it is often cruel reality that awaits.
He's known this.
He's known he is not ready.
Perhaps he would still try to fly beyond the mountains, but not in this way.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Don't worry, we'll be back soon.

steps.name: Teacher
steps.text: Any movement?

steps.name: Bounty Hunter
steps.text: No.

steps.name: Teacher
steps.text: Alright.

steps.name: Teacher
steps.text: I hope you brought good news.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: I—I talked to them. They won't suspect anything for a while.

steps.name: Teacher
steps.text: Looks like you kept our deal.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: How did these people—

steps.name: Teacher
steps.text: Well, if you really want to know... they just marched in like they owned the place.

steps.name: Teacher
steps.text: Kjerag is too primitive. This might be the easiest job we've ever done.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: What are you going to do to Enciodes?

steps.name: Teacher
steps.text: Easy. Make Master Olafur pay a little price for his carelessness.

steps.name: Teacher
steps.text: Then, we head for Victoria.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: We?

steps.name: Teacher
steps.text: Yes, we.

steps.name: Teacher
steps.text: Did you think I was going to fail to uphold my end of the deal?

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Isn't that what crooks do best?

steps.name: Teacher
steps.text: Now, don't be so sarcastic, boy.

steps.name: Teacher
steps.text: You can hate me now.

steps.name: Teacher
steps.text: I'll send you to school, help you learn whatever you want. All I ask is a little favor every now and then.

steps.name: Teacher
steps.text: It's a good deal, isn't it?

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Enciodes must be hungry. I'll bring him his food.

steps.name: Teacher
steps.text: Sure... You can say goodbye.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Oh, I didn't expect you. I thought it would be somebody else.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Are you sure about revealing your involvement? Things won't go well for you if I somehow manage to get out.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: You sure are confident.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Just a little joke.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: My family—

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: They don't know yet.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Yes, with your cover story, it'll take them some time to realize that I've been kidnapped.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Our teacher sure is thorough, isn't he?

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: It's time to eat.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: How am I supposed to eat with my hands tied behind my back?

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Go on, feed me.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Thanks. The taste's not so bad.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Aren't you scared?

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Sure I'm scared. But that won't help. I was thinking maybe I should get used to this.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Are you out of your mind?

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: This is the state of Kjerag right now. So weak that this may not be the last time something like this happens.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Are you going to leave Kjerag with that man?

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: None of your business.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: I would say it is, given that it was passage bought with my safety.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: ...I suppose you're right.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Why? Did you dislike Kjerag?

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: I don't dislike it. I just... I don't know. I don't understand why people like my father would bury their heads in history, obsessing over the events of the past.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: I can't help but feel the urge to run away when I think about how I'm supposed to become a scholar like him.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Ah, your father. We've met a few times. Not the easiest man to get along with.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: I should have invited you to my house more often.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Maybe I wouldn't have had to deal with my two sisters so much if I introduced you.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: I doubt I would have gotten along with them either.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Is there anything you want to do once you get out?

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: ...I haven't decided.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Well, that's not good. But then, my father says that he began his studies with no particular goal in mind, then began to find one along the way.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: You—

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: You're the one in danger. Stop worrying about me.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Come now, Gnosis.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: You wanted to leave Kjerag because it's boring. Am I right?

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Not entirely.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: You wouldn't understand.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: I suppose I wouldn't. Not entirely, at least.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: But what if I told you that I can make Kjerag less boring?

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: I haven't told anyone else. Keep it secret for me.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: I understand why Father says that Kjerag is weak and needs to learn to accept compromise.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: But I'm getting tired of seeing him bow his head to foreigners. It's like you said: Boring.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: We need to be stronger, tougher, fiercer. Let the foreigners know that they can't walk over the people of Kjerag so easily.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Shh—

steps.name: Bounty Hunter
steps.text: Alright, visiting hours are over.

steps.name: Bounty Hunter
steps.text: What are you dallying for? The boss is looking for you. I'll watch this one.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Hmph.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Do you always carry an Arts Unit with you, Gnosis?

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: I took the scenic route.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Don't move, I'll untie you.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: I felt safer when I was tied up.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: They don't see Kjerag as an equal partner. Give them an inch, and they'll take a mile.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Makes sense.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: I'm sorry... I didn't know he would do that.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: I'm starting to like you, Gnosis.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Oh?

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: I thought our little chat was proof enough that I forgive you.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: This is this and that is that.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Getting you kidnapped and rescuing you after having second thoughts are two different matters.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: That's what I like.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: So, do you have a plan to get away?

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: A sliver of one. I've been thinking about it.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: So you came to rescue me from the get-go?

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: That's not what I said.

steps.name: Bounty Hunter
steps.text: Gotcha!

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Hmph.

steps.name: Bounty Hunter
steps.text: What's that? Trying to scratch an itch?

steps.name: Bounty Hunter
steps.text: Surrender, and maybe the boss will let you off easy.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: In your dreams.

steps.name: Bounty Hunter
steps.text: Gugh—

steps.name: Bounty Hunter
steps.text: You... won't... get... away...

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Well, that was close.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Can I ask a question?

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: You're intentionally making noise along the way, right? Like how you used Arts in that fight just now.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Yes, because—

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Here they come.

steps.name: Teacher
steps.text: This was not smart, Gnosis.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: I agree.

steps.name: Teacher
steps.text: Can you tell me why?

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: It's true that I don't like my life right now.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: I don't know what kind of life I want.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: But that doesn't mean I want to leave with you.

steps.name: Teacher
steps.text: What a shame.

steps.name: Teacher
steps.text: You've lost your one shot at freedom.

steps.name: Teacher
steps.text: Here, you'll never know how big the world outside is.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Not necessarily.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: How do you know that world doesn't lie in the future of Kjerag?

steps.name: Teacher
steps.text: My dear Master Enciodes, do you really think that Victoria will allow you to develop?

steps.name: Teacher
steps.text: Victoria takes pity on Kjerag at the moment, because you're too weak.

steps.name: Teacher
steps.text: They will reap the fruit that belongs to them, when the time comes.

steps.name: Teacher
steps.text: You're only 'developing' for their sake.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: I've heard this many times, and my answer is the same as my father's.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: We'll see.

steps.name: Teacher
steps.text: Hah. Do you think you'll get the chance?

steps.name: Teacher
steps.text: You're a long way from town. Even if your father realizes you've disappeared, it'll take a long time for him to find you.

steps.name: Teacher
steps.text: No one will save you.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: No.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: You outsiders don't know Kjerag.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: A lot of wild burdenbeasts live in these lush forests.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Before the people of Kjerag learned to domesticate them, this was where they caught wild burdenbeasts and tamed them. You're hiding in one of the old ruins that they left behind.

steps.name: Teacher
steps.text: Burdenbeasts? What are those docile animals going to do?

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: A common misunderstanding. Burdenbeasts are not naturally docile. The tame ones that you see are the result of centuries of domestication.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: In the wild, burdenbeasts are—

steps.name: Bounty Hunter A
steps.text: What's going on?!

steps.name: Bounty Hunter B
steps.text: Over there! Burdenbeasts! A whole stampede of them!

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Wild burdenbeasts don't like to be disturbed while they're resting.

steps.name: Teacher
steps.text: Get them!

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: You better know how to ride a burdenbeast, Enciodes!

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Ha! Who do you think you're talking to?

steps.name: Wild Burdenbeast
steps.text: (Excited cry)

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Good boy, good boy.

steps.name: Wild Burdenbeast
steps.text: (Placid cry)

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Sorry to interrupt your rest.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: You can go now.

steps.name: Wild Burdenbeast
steps.text: (Low cry)

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: We should be safe now.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Yes, the commotion has probably caught the attention of people in town. All we need to do is hide until they find us.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Then—

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Well, let's hope Master Olafur's fury doesn't extend to my family.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: What are you talking about, Gnosis?

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: You're the hero who rescued me.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: You must be joking. No excuse can change the fact that I—

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: What does it matter? Friends are supposed to forgive each other's mistakes.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Friends?

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Friends.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Matterhorn has been with me since I was little, and Weiss's situation is kind of unusual. I don't have any other friends.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: You'll be the first.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Let's make a promise, Gnosis.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: I'll make Kjerag big enough for you.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: And you'll stay.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: What kind of promise is that?

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: No good?

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: If we're going to do this, we'll make Kjerag big enough for the both of us.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: You're on board?

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: You did say I'm the first friend you've made other than Matterhorn and Weiss?

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: I did.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: You're my first friend, too.
